body_markdown:
**EAST RUTHERFORD, NJ, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —**[Mama’s Creations, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=GnF_osnYHJ77g_OgjTmIl8EPi02Lcwmdhq8w863__FC151Bvpl8j37HFXbapQ2oXsCKxTxyqi4N_PZ7Ft6XrkBh9JK1i7yRaRKaHIk1MZpc=) (NASDAQ: MAMA), a leading national marketer and manufacturer of fresh Deli prepared foods, will release financial results for the fiscal third quarter ended October 31, 2026 after market close on December 8, 2026.


Management will host an investor conference call at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time on Tuesday, December 8, 2026 to discuss the Company’s third quarter fiscal 2027 financial results, provide a corporate update, and conclude with Q&A from telephone participants. To participate, please use the following information:


**Q3 FY2027 Earnings Conference Call**
Date: Tuesday, December 8, 2026
Time: 4:30 p.m. Eastern time
U.S. Dial-in: 1-877-451-6152
International Dial-in: 1-201-389-0879
Conference ID: 13763785
Webcast:[MAMA Q3 FY2027 Earnings Conference Call](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AUSpH8yWDOFD5foAryFUCXLUtNPIWjRNJ_4HLHx2ryKOgVEbB7wMOKVgTa6x8al-yD189ptr-j8UuYc9mc0mWPg2UbSCanJs0Ovh_cCnmb4P236Cy09fcM_Q_hj4ViUxk9MSAzzpk8E-ttBkViMaV2HKkeAUkcgjT-frF_YNueuasvLQ49ZtUaRTFht-oO13)


Please join at least five minutes before the start of the call to ensure timely participation.


Adam L. Michaels, Chairman and CEO of Mama’s Creations, said: “As we approach the close of fiscal 2027, our 4Cs framework – cost, controls, culture and catapult – continues to guide everything we do. On the operational side, that means we are always making improvements across our facilities and teams, refining how we execute as the business scales – all with the same discipline and long-term focus that have guided us since day one. On the catapult side, we continue to see exciting momentum, which positions us for robust sales growth entering our next fiscal year. We look forward to discussing our third quarter results and providing a broader update on the business on our upcoming call.”


A playback of the call will be available through Tuesday, December 22, 2026. To listen, please call 1-844-512-2921 within the United States and Canada or 1-412-317-6671 when calling internationally, using replay pin number 13763785. A webcast replay will also be available using the webcast link above.


**About Mama’s Creations, Inc.**


Mama’s Creations, Inc. (Nasdaq: MAMA) is a leading marketer and manufacturer of fresh deli prepared foods, found in over 12,000 grocery, mass, club and convenience stores nationally. The Company’s broad product portfolio, born from MamaMancini’s rich history in Italian foods, now consists of a variety of high quality, fresh, clean and easy to prepare foods to address the needs of both our consumers and retailers. Our vision is to become a one-stop-shop deli solutions platform, leveraging vertical integration and a diverse family of brands to offer a wide array of prepared foods to meet the changing demands of the modern consumer. For more information, please visit[https://mamascreations.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wxtxs_PfDs7jW_HzuTXobYqH3zRFj3NxS1fHfv-knTJrhaxN0DuxULUs4uw_UgwZYj58ZomZugpNuKYiN1Lxl-dBJgSGUBLx1qMe00IJkGk=) .
